findings: The entry loop applies a flag-dependent precheck, a shared-entry predicate and indirect status checks before collecting entries for a later indirect action. Status 0/2 admission and status 4 exclusion are raw observed branches, not verified component post-states.

The action router distinguishes numeric arguments 0-3 and delegates to debugger, property and persistence routines. The literal property keys are disabledAfterReboot and autoRedeactivation; their names alone do not prove an effect.

The association predicate obtains two manager-provided string collections and normalizes matches in the second to the selected key. A remaining differing key must produce a nonzero query-call result and a nonempty returned range for ActualProgramModifications. Record presence does not verify a native Sleeping state.

Source-bound SQL constants establish persistence modes 1=read, 2=update an existing row, 3=insert when missing, 4=insert-or-update, 5=delete. The Data payload grammar and runtime write results remain unverified.

The debugger delegate constructs a subkey beneath Windows Image File Execution Options. Its filtered path prepares Debugger, FilterFullPath and UseFilter values; Debugger/FilterFullPath write failures can continue to later writes, while UseFilter failure invokes a cleanup delegate. No native read-back occurs in that wrapper.

The string writer accepts raw type codes 1/2 and computes bytes through a UTF-16 terminator. The underlying writer calls RegCreateKeyExW, RegSetValueExW and RegCloseKey; the value-write status becomes its boolean result and SetLastError value. An access-denied create can retry with raw option 0x4. This observed fallback is not a DCleaner privilege or readiness implementation.

One native writer spans three original metadata-chained unwind ranges; all its retained body, assembly, CFG and value-flow facets lie in their union. Registry cleanup, matching and hash-name helpers retain separate limits until their concrete semantics are reviewed.

Scoped cleanup leaves reach RegDeleteValueW, RegDeleteKeyExW, RegEnumKeyW/RegEnumKeyExW and registry query APIs. The recursive key helper enumerates index zero repeatedly and tries parent deletion after any nonzero enumeration status; a later delete status can replace that earlier error. A separate precheck maps missing-key status 2 to success.

The Debugger cleanup caller requires a nonzero comparator result; the comparator returns true when an unresolved string helper returns zero. This is a match gate, not established ownership. Its trailing INT3 and eleven flow operations outside the PE scope are excluded.

A postprocessing gate tests reported subkey and value counts for zero; error propagation and the selected operation remain separate questions. Another cleanup-wrapper output-equality gate is not established as an empty-key predicate.

The value-read wrapper has an assembly/value-flow discrepancy: the caller path remains in RDX at the machine-code call, while the decompiler models a zero argument. That conflict and the nested data conversion remain open.

The bounded return-check helper preserves RAX/EAX/AL on its successful RET path. The state router has observed numeric 0/1 status routes, and the deactivation wrapper returns its prepared byte on that normal path; these are not component post-state receipts.
